description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/studio/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/studio/questions.pdf; its answer (3) is the answer printed in the PDF.

Q01 is the only question in benchmark_2 without a machine-readable spec: iref merges the three framed records into one object, so scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py reports it as unverified by design. Every other answer in this file is recomputed from the bounding boxes.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.
studio is a single open-plan loft (one iref region), so no question needs a region restriction.

Pillows and books are not used as count targets: iref annotates the six couch pillows as one 'pillows' object and each shelf row of books as one 'books' object, so neither number matches what a human would count.
Q05, Q06 and Q07 are deliberately paired: the four boxes split two in the bookcase and two on the window shelf.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many framed records are above the couch?
questions.evidence: Three framed gold and platinum records hang in a row on the wall above the couch (one silver, one gold, one silver).
questions.annotation_note: iref annotates the row of three records as a single 'framed record' object (11), so this answer comes from the reference image and the PDF, not from the bounding boxes.

questions.question: How many vases are on the cabinet below the TV?
questions.evidence: Three brass vases of decreasing height (24, 25, 26) stand on top of the long dark cabinet 55, which sits below wall-mounted TV 14.

questions.question: How many beer bottles are on the coffee table?
questions.evidence: Two green beer bottles (54, 72) stand on coffee table 63 in front of the couch, next to the newspaper and the phone.

questions.question: How many vases are standing on the floor?
questions.evidence: Two vases stand directly on the floor: the large teardrop vase 27 at the end of the TV cabinet and the tall vase 46 with the orange twigs by the couch. The other four vases are on or inside the cabinet.

questions.question: How many boxes are on the long shelf below the windows?
questions.evidence: Boxes 32 and 43 sit side by side on low shelf 71, which runs the length of the wall below the two dormer windows; the rest of that shelf holds a row of books.

questions.question: How many boxes are inside the bookcase?
questions.evidence: Two boxes (22, 35) are stored in the lower compartments of bookcase 58; the other two boxes in the studio are on the shelf below the windows.

questions.question: How many boxes are in the studio in total?
questions.evidence: Four boxes: 22 and 35 in the bookcase, 32 and 43 on the shelf below the windows.

questions.question: How many focus lights are on the ceiling?
questions.evidence: Eight recessed focus lights (49, 51, 52, 64, 66, 67, 69, 70) in two rows of four.

questions.question: How many windows are in the studio?
questions.evidence: Two large dormer windows (5, 42) in the sloped wall behind the long book shelf.

questions.question: How many chairs are in the studio?
questions.evidence: A single black egg-shaped swivel chair (40) with a pillow on it, facing the coffee table.
